g.title: public.units
g.text: A rentable flat, room or shop in a building.

g.title: public.organizations
g.text: A landlord's organisation. Readable in its own context, by its members and by admin; updated only by its landlord or admin.

g.title: public.buildings
g.text: A building with its billing calendar and late-fee rule.

g.title: public.unit_charges
g.text: Fixed monthly charges of a unit (service, water, gas...).

g.title: public.leases
g.text: A tenancy of one unit. One live (pending/active/notice) lease per unit.

g.title: public.maintenance_requests
g.text: Tenant repair requests and their state.
